parameters.formDescription: Review drafts the agent wrote. Nothing is published until you approve it here. Your edits and reasons teach the agent.

parameters.jsCode:
const ops = $('Decisions').first().json.ops;
return ops.length ? ops.map(o => ({ json: o })) : [{ json: { stage: 0 } }];

const r = $('Decisions').first().json.revisions;
return r.length ? r.map(x => ({ json: x })) : [{ json: { item_id: '', reason: '' } }];
